framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure requirement when any person acquires 5% or more of voting capital of a listed company, or exercises control; applies to substantial acquisitions in stages.
Definition of 'acquirer' and 'control' for purposes of substantial acquisition triggers.
Exemptions and safe harbour provisions for certain categories of acquirers (e.g., government, financial institutions in certain circumstances).
Approval of acquisitions above certain thresholds where change of control is involved; may apply depending on structure.
Public announcement requirements and pricing norms if the disclosure is linked to an open offer obligation.
Continuous disclosure obligations for listed entities on material events and acquisition of shares.

headline: Urban Company Limited files SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure
sum: Urban Company Limited submitted a SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, indicating a material acquisition event requiring formal disclosure to NSE.
detail: Urban Company Limited disclosed to NSE a filing under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), which mandates disclosure of acquisitions of 5% or more of voting shares or control by any acquirer. The specific identity of the acquirer, quantum of stake, and acquisition consideration are not disclosed in the available public disclosures reviewed. This is a regulatory filing event, not a transaction announcement.
